description: An immutable change appended to a grid cell's history.

itemUUID.description: UUID (Universally Unique IDentifier) for this item. Clients must issue a new UUID for each history item generated.

cellValue.description: The value of the cell, set by the user, at the time this item was generated.

changedById.description: The ID of the user that made this change

changedOn.description: The date-time when the user made this change.

agentAssist.description: When true, this change was made by an agent on the changeById user's behalf.

gridVersion.description: The current version number of the grid at the time this change was made.
